method: Campground coordinates were resolved from Recreation.gov facility and campsite records, then checked against named Google Maps destinations. Seattle routes use current ordinary driving estimates; public display times add a towing and traffic margin. Bedal uses the Forest Service-recommended Darrington approach.

reviews.coordinate_source: Recreation.gov facility point corroborated by its campsite coordinate cluster and Forest Service directions from I-90 Exit 42
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-90 route at review time. Tinkham Road is gravel and conditions vary; Recreation.gov recommends access from Exit 42. Public estimate adds a towing and traffic margin.

reviews.coordinate_source: Recreation.gov facility point corroborated by its campsite coordinate cluster and official Kachess Lake Road directions
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-90 and Kachess Lake Road route at review time. Public estimate adds a towing, pass-traffic, and local-road margin.

reviews.address: Mountain Loop Highway, Granite Falls, WA 98252
reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps named Verlot Campground point corroborated by Recreation.gov facility coordinates and Forest Service directions
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-5, WA-9, WA-92, and Mountain Loop Highway route at review time. Public estimate adds a towing and traffic margin.

reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps named Gold Basin Campground point corroborated by Recreation.gov campsite coordinates; the Recreation.gov facility point resolves across the highway at Gold Basin Mill Pond
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-5, WA-9, WA-92, and Mountain Loop Highway route at review time. Directions use the named campground rather than the mill pond across the highway.

reviews.address: 32910 Mountain Loop Highway, Granite Falls, WA 98252
reviews.coordinate_source: Recreation.gov facility point matched to the Google Maps routed campground address and official Mountain Loop Highway directions
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-5, WA-9, WA-92, and Mountain Loop Highway route at review time. Public estimate adds a towing and traffic margin.

reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps named Bedal Campground point corroborated by Recreation.gov facility and campsite coordinates
reviews.route_note: Uses the Forest Service-recommended approach through Darrington on WA-530. The final 7.5 miles are gravel and variable; the Barlow Pass approach may be gated.

reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-5, SR-20, Baker Lake Road, and NF-1118 route at review time. Public estimate adds a towing and traffic margin.
